etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 東 (phonetic チン) — set out in rows: to display, state; long-set: stale (陳腐).
mnemonic: Goods lined along the eastern wall — チン. 陳列: the shop window verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 聿 (phonetic シン) — the crossing point: ferry port.
mnemonic: Where the boats write their arrivals — つ. 津波: the wave that finds every port.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 隊 (phonetic ツイ) + earth (土) — down to the ground: to plummet.
mnemonic: Altitude, then geology — ツイ. 墜落: the aviation word.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 隹 (phonetic ツイ) — the chinquapin oak; the spine's stacked 'mallets': vertebrae (脊椎).
mnemonic: The tree in your back — つい. 椎間板: the discs between.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 冢 (phonetic チョウ→つか) — the raised burial mound: hillock.
mnemonic: The little hill someone made on purpose — つか. 貝塚: the shell mound archaeologists love.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 責 (phonetic シ→つ) — steeped under weight: to pickle.
mnemonic: Vegetables doing time in brine — つける. 漬物: the rice bowl's sidekick.

etymology: Compound: land (土) leveled (平) — the tsubo, two tatami of ground: ~3.3m².
mnemonic: Real estate's atomic unit — つぼ. 30坪: the house ad's number.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 勺 (phonetic チョウ) — the hook that ladles fish out: to angle; balanced exchange: change (お釣り).
mnemonic: Metal spoon-hook in the water — つる. お釣り: the change fished back to you.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + bird (鳥) — the thousand-year bird: crane.
mnemonic: The origami everyone learns first — つる. 千羽鶴: a thousand of them, folded in hope.

etymology: Phono-semantic: the tall-building form + 丁 (phonetic テイ) — the roadside rest-house: pavilion, and rakugo stage names (〜亭).
mnemonic: The teahouse with a poet's name-board — テイ. 料亭: dining at pavilion prices.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 貞 (phonetic テイ) — sent to find out: scout, detective.
mnemonic: The quiet one who reports back — テイ. 探偵: the trench-coat kanji.

etymology: Compound: divining (卜) at the tripod (貝) — the true reading: constancy, virtue.
mnemonic: The oracle's answer that doesn't bend — テイ. 貞子, ironically, from the horror well.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 王-form (phonetic テイ) — held up before: to present, exhibit.
mnemonic: Offered up with an announcement — テイ. 贈呈: the trophy handover.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 是 (phonetic テイ) — the raised bank: levee.
mnemonic: Earth doing the river's paperwork — つつみ. 堤防: the flood's opponent.

etymology: Pictograph: the great altar of highest heaven — its lord: the emperor.
mnemonic: The title above kings — テイ. 帝国: empire — the altar with an army.

etymology: Compound: officials in file (壬) in the long hall (廴) — the court: imperial or legal.
mnemonic: The corridor where verdicts walk — テイ. 法廷: the courtroom.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 氐 (phonetic テイ) — braced at the base: to resist; roughly (大抵).
mnemonic: Heels dug to the root — テイ. 抵抗: resistance, physics and teenagers.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 帝 (phonetic テイ) — bound fast: to tighten, conclude (a pact).
mnemonic: The knot pulled to imperial standards — しめる. 締め切り: the deadline — the rope's end.

etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 廷 (phonetic テイ) — the light craft: boat.
mnemonic: The boat small enough to carry upstairs — テイ. 競艇: powerboat racing.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 丁 (phonetic テイ) — the text nailed straight: to correct.
mnemonic: Hammering the typos flat — テイ. 訂正: the correction notice.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + a phonetic (テイ) — passed station to station: relay.
mnemonic: The parcel changing hands down the line — テイ. 逓信: the old post-and-telegraph ministry.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 氐 (phonetic テイ) + city (阝) — the noble's town seat: mansion.
mnemonic: The address with gates — テイ. 豪邸: the mansion tour word.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 啇 (phonetic テキ) — plucked out precisely: to pick; to single out (指摘).
mnemonic: Two fingers on the exact flaw — つむ. 指摘: the reviewer's pinch.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 折 (phonetic テツ) + mouth (口) — discerning speech: wisdom: philosophy.
mnemonic: Ideas broken open and examined aloud — テツ. 哲学: the department of good questions.

etymology: Compound: carried through to the end (彳...攵) — all the way: thorough.
mnemonic: Through the wall, not around — テツ. 徹夜: through the whole night.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + the 徹 phonetic — taken all the way out: to withdraw.
mnemonic: Everything packed back out the way it came — テツ. 撤退: the organized retreat.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 失 (phonetic テツ) — one out, one in: alternation (更迭).
mnemonic: The minister walks, the replacement arrives — テツ. 更迭: the cabinet reshuffle word.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic (テン) — added alongside: to attach, accompany.
mnemonic: Poured in beside, not instead — そえる. 添付: the email attachment; 付き添い: the human one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 土 (phonetic ト) — out of the mouth: to spit, disgorge, confess (吐く).
mnemonic: What the mouth returns to earth — はく. 弱音を吐く: spitting out one's weakness.

etymology: Pictograph: the grain ladle — the measure (18L); the sky's ladle: the Big Dipper.
mnemonic: The scoop hanging in the north sky — ト. 北斗七星: the seven-starred ladle.

etymology: Compound: the seized servant (女+又) — slave; roughened into 'that guy' (あいつ's kanji).
mnemonic: History's harshest kanji gone slangy — やつ. 奴ら: 'those guys'.

etymology: The name of the T'ang dynasty — the China of Japan's classical imports: Chinese, foreign (唐揚げ's 唐).
mnemonic: The dynasty that shipped Japan its alphabet — トウ. 唐揚げ: T'ang-style frying, allegedly.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 卓 (phonetic トウ) — the heart bowed for the dead: to mourn.
mnemonic: Grief for someone who stood tall — いたむ. 追悼: the memorial address.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 荅 (phonetic トウ) — loaded aboard: to board, mount.
mnemonic: Bags up, body in — トウ. 搭乗: the boarding-gate kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 兆 (phonetic トウ) — the auspicious fruit tree: peach.
mnemonic: The tree of good omens — もも. 桃太郎: the boy the peach delivered.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 東 (phonetic トウ) — the roof's spine beam: ridgepole; the counter for buildings.
mnemonic: The beam the whole roof salutes — むね. 病棟: the hospital wing.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 豆 (phonetic トウ) — the bean-like pustules: smallpox.
mnemonic: Illness in bean-shaped spots — トウ. 種痘: the vaccine that ended it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + a phonetic (トウ) — the cascading vine: wisteria; half of Japan's surnames (佐藤, 伊藤).
mnemonic: The purple waterfall of May — ふじ. 藤: on trellises and business cards everywhere.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + words (言) — words carried over: transcript.
mnemonic: The certified word-for-word — トウ. 謄本: the family register copy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 沓 (phonetic トウ) — the foot coming down: to tread.
mnemonic: Weight onto the board — ふむ. 踏切: the crossing you stop at; 踏まえる: standing on the facts.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 秀 (phonetic トウ) — passing clean through: transparent.
mnemonic: Light walks through without knocking — すける. 透明: the clear kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound/kiln (阝) + 匋 (phonetic トウ) — clay fired at the hill kiln: ceramics; absorbed delight (陶酔).
mnemonic: The hillside kiln's output — トウ. 陶器: the shelf you don't let children near.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + horse (馬) — the horse rearing: to leap; prices doing it: surge.
mnemonic: The chart bolting like a spooked horse — トウ. 高騰: the headline about eggs.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 鬥, two fighters facing off): combat at the gate: to fight.
mnemonic: The brawl in the doorway — たたかう. 闘う: 戦う's scrappier twin — illness, matches, Mondays.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 童 (phonetic ショウ/ドウ) — the child-heart looking up: to long for.
mnemonic: The kid's poster on the wall — あこがれる. 憧れ: the senpai effect.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 同 (phonetic ドウ) — the hollowed space: cave; seeing into it: insight (洞察).
mnemonic: The hollow the river carved — ほら. 洞窟: the cave proper.

etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 童 (phonetic ドウ) — the child in the eye (the tiny reflection): pupil.
mnemonic: Look close: a small someone looks back — ひとみ. 瞳: songwriting's favorite anatomy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 同 (phonetic ドウ) — the body's barrel: torso.
mnemonic: The body minus its extremities — ドウ. 胴上げ: the victory toss.
